answer: A farm faces 4 hours at the counter for every name, counted one by one for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. To join, a name must pass Crownbound jewel sorter pearl licence, which works because a licence jewel sorters carry after lapidary workroom audits. Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. The clerk notes ledge. The signal is on the docket. One wharf, one entry.
